name: trigger_mail_fails_with_non_success_response
goal: Bot handles a non-success response from the mail triggering workflow gracefully.
constraints: Employee details must be present. Mail workflow returns a response without 'success'.

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and options.
Bot does not display any confirmation or error message (per rules). Task ends silently.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
